title: Chuck Lorre Talks David Ellison Optimism, Scientology and the Perks (Really!) of Working for Roseanne Barr
summary: A week after publishing memoir 'Sitcom,' the comedy writer reveals hopes for Warner Bros' new ownership and skirts the 'Roseanne' writing credit debate by saying all were better for working there — even if "it might have crushed their soul in the process."
